messages:
marta: heads-up — after the kernel-selector change this morning i'm seeing sustained KV residency drop on our long-context perf runs (>=32k). eviction counters spike around 3-4m into the run. dashboard: https://graf.redwood/kvdash/abc123 :eyes:

sam: link? can you paste the prom queries/panels so we can reproduce? is it across all pools or one region?

marta: narrowed to two pools (g7x-rt and g7x-burst). quick promql i used:
```promql
sum by(pool) (increase(kv_evictions_total[5m]))
/
sum by(pool) (increase(kv_insert_ops_total[5m]))
```
this gives eviction ratio; also looking at `kv_residency_percent` and `kv_frag_ratio` panels.

perf-bot: regression detected: long-ctx-throughput (32k incremental) down 12% vs baseline after CL 4872 (kernel-selector). linked run: https://ci.redwood/longctx/4872

kevin: possible cause: kernel-selector started favoring tiled-attn kernel which changes allocation patterns for KV pages. that kernel uses smaller slabs for kv blocks -> more fragmentation under long sequences.

anita: sounds plausible. we should add an eviction-rate alert + residency guardrail. proposed alert: `kv_residency_percent < 80 and increase(kv_evictions_total[10m]) > 0.05` for 5m. thoughts?

ops-oncall: yes add runbook too. when triggered: 1) pin model to compatible kernel (fallback), 2) bump cache-residency target or clear problematic pool, 3) open pager if user-facing latency > 5s. need exact playbook steps.

sam: i'm going to capture a heap profile and KV page diff during a repro. marta — can you kick off a 1-hr long-ctx job on canary with verbose KV debug flags?

marta: started job canary/kv-repro-178210 at 1782102400. debug flags: `KV_DEBUG=allocs,evict,frag` and sampling 1/1000. logs: https://logs.redwood/kv/1782102400

kevin: quick fix possibility: change slab size heuristic to favor larger arenas for tiled-attn code-path when seq_len > 8k. i'll prototype and run unit/regressions.

marta: created dashboard patch + panel: "KV top evicting pools" + alert rule. PR: https://git.redwood/platform/patches/3129 — includes example panel queries and runbook link.

anita: please also expose `kv_evictions_by_cause` label so we can distinguish pager vs policy evictions. that'll help isolate kernel vs runtime policy issues.

perf-bot: note: regression trace shows eviction bursts align with GC window at ~180s, and increased mem fragmentation metric `kv_frag_ratio`.

marta: TL;DR actions: 1) add eviction-by-cause metric (kevin) 2) add residency alert + runbook (anita/ops) 3) patch slab-heuristic prototype (kevin) 4) add long-ctx perf test to CI (sam) 5) correlate kernel-selector flags in dashboards (marta). i'll follow up with a short RFC tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
